en: The image shows the reverse side of an old postcard with handwritten text in a cursive script covering the left half, address lines on the right, and multiple overlapping circular postal cancellation marks in the upper center-right. The printed heading reads "POSTKAART – CARTE POSTALE" in red. The address appears to include a street name and number and a recipient's name. There is a faint box at the top right where a stamp would have been placed.
